views: SELECT view_name FROM views() UNION ALL SELECT view_name FROM materialized_views()
SELECT table_name AS view_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_type IN ('VIEW', 'MATERIALIZED VIEW')

tableStatus.sql: SELECT t.table_name AS table_name, '' AS table_comment, s.rowCount AS table_rows, s.diskSize AS data_length, NULL AS index_length FROM tables() t LEFT JOIN table_storage() s ON s.tableName = t.table_name WHERE t.table_type = 'T' ORDER BY t.table_name

SELECT t.table_name AS table_name, '' AS table_comment, s.rowCount AS table_rows, s.diskSize AS data_length, NULL AS index_length FROM tables() t LEFT JOIN table_storage() s ON s.tableName = t.table_name WHERE NOT t.matView ORDER BY t.table_name
SELECT table_name, '' AS table_comment, NULL AS table_rows, NULL AS data_length, NULL AS index_length FROM tables() ORDER BY table_name
